implementation.summary: Evidence set for the seven inspection-only ACs, written to execution/T-12/evidence/ in the MAIN repo (not the worktree): shell-{light,dark}-{no-session,session-active}.png. Verdicts - AC-12 PASS (three tabs in order, Notes selected, bezel-less stage; also pinned by ShellTabTest). AC-30 PASS with partial comparison (both palettes render completely and legibly, tokens swap consistently; NO dark design comp exists so the honest claim is 'renders correctly and consistently', NOT 'matches the design'). AC-31 PASS (no-session renders no panel AND no resize hairline; enforced structurally by the nullable slot). AC-34 PASS for geometry via live probe, resize DRAG unverified. AC-36 PASS (zero diff in presentation-core-styling). AC-37 PASS (slot order matches comp 02; intentional deltas: the AC-35 theme toggle absent from the comp, and a single NO SIGNAL placeholder instead of the comp's dashed outline + onboarding steps + Boot control, which are downstream scope). AC-40 WEAK EVIDENCE - the only signal-bearing element in the stub states is the Offline dot, which reads a neutral token; PaletteContrastTest is the real coverage, not these screenshots.
